parsed.rationale: Results are sliced by ICD chapter and by simulated profile condition, with n reported for the ICD chapter and ICD block slices (profile slices carry no n). No results by demographic subgroup of the source patient data are given, and the packet does not state that no demographic fields exist, so element (ii) is absent. Profile attributes are benchmark-assigned simulator settings, not source demographics.
